Which of the following statement is NOT correct?

I. The number of girls in year Y6 is 9 percent of the number of boys in year Y6.

II. The average number of boys in year Y1 and Y2 are 80.
solution:
**Calculation:**

The statement I

The number of girls in year Y6 is 90

The number of boys in year Y6 is 100

The number of girls in year Y6 is 90 percent of the number of boys in year Y6 not the 9 %

The statement II

The average number of boys in year Y1 and Y2 are 90 + 70 / 2 = 80

So this one is correct.

**∴ The correct option is 1**
